[1:09:34 PM] 
 
>> Tovo: Welcome. I am mayor pro tem Kathie tovo, the vice chair of this committee. I'd like to call us to 
order at 1:09 P.M. Our chair will not be with us today, but we do have a quorum. Is there any citizens 
communication? Do we have any citizens signed up to speak to us today? Okay. Seeing none, we have 
one main order of business today, and that is to discuss candidates for appointment to the municipal 
civil service commission, and to do that we will -- we're now going to go into closed session to take up 
one item pursuant to section 551074 of the government code, the committee is going to discuss 
candidates for appointment to municipal civil service commission. Is there any objection to going into 
executive session on this item? Hearing none, we are now going to be in executive session at 1:11 P.M. 
For any of you watching, we will return to -- after our executive session, we'll return to this room and 
conduct any additional business.  
 
[1:40:01 PM] 
 
>>> >> >>> >> >>> >> >>>  
 
[2:00:15 PM] 
 
>> Tovo: Welcome back. We are out of closed session. In closed session we took up personnel matters 
related to our civil service commission. Now we're coming back. It's 1:55. We decided -- well, actually, 
we reviewed the applications and I believe that there will be a motion from someone to interview 
particular candidates. >> I move to invite for an interview five candidates, and alphabetically I have 
Lonnie Dailey, Ronald Morgan, Michael measurety, Michael petrotrovski and [inaudible] Turner. >> 
Tovo: Second? By the mayor. Any discussion? So that passes. And that will happen at our regularly 
scheduled audit and finance meeting, but there is also a potential of having a special called meeting, but 
at this point we'll proceed with one of those options. Any other business? Today? All right. Very good. 
We stand adjourned at 1:57.
